newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Kohl wants reasonable talks with Buba on gold plan.
newsitem.headline: Kohl wants reasonable talks with Buba on gold plan.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl said on Monday that he wanted to have "reasonable talks" with the Bundesbank about controversial plans to revalue assets.
Kohl stressed again that the only difference between Bonn and the Bundesbank on the gold and reserves revaluation plan was the timing.
"I am in favour of reasonable discussions (with the Bundesbank) on the gold issue," Kohl said.

The Bundesbank last week issued a strongly-worded statement protesting against Bonn's plans to call for a transfer of book profits notched up as a result of the revaluation of assets both this year and next, saying it hurt its independence.
